1. i saw you yesterday by the library, carrying a stack of paperback books with rubber bands around them. 2. you looked exactly the same, only your hair was a little whiter and your coat was a different shade of brown. 3. i wanted to walk past, because it has been twelve years and i was never your brightest student. 4. but you stopped by the stone steps, looked at me, and asked if i was still drawing in the margins of my notebooks. 5. we stood in the autumn wind for five minutes, talking about the old radiator that used to clank in room ten. 6. i was about to say goodbye and walk to my car, but i stopped. 7. i looked at my boots and finally said the thing i kept to myself all through high school. 8. "i only passed that class," i told you, "because you let me sit by the window on the days my head hurt."
✍️ Caption
sometimes they are the only reason we made it through the year. they noticed us when we were trying so hard to be invisible. send this to the teacher who changed everything for you.
